checkRuns.command:
sed -i "0,/^---$/s//---\nexport const prerender = false;/" src/pages/404.astro && head -4 src/pages/404.astro
bun run check 2>&1 | grep -E "errors" ; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?
PORT=4719 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4719 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
for p in /books/nope /zzz; do curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "$p %{http_code} " localhost:4719$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/o; done
kill %1
